name: P50_B
story_text:
《深水惊魂》

一、平静与威胁浮现

黄昏。开阔海面，光线低而暖。一艘小型机动渔船缓慢航行，尾迹拖出淡淡白线。船尾，中年船长穿着油布外套，双手扶住舵盘，目光平静地注视前方。前甲板上，年轻大副穿着水手服，弯腰收拢散落的渔网，动作熟练而从容。海面平静，只有细碎波纹。

忽然，远处海平线下方海水颜色骤然变深，一个巨大阴影在浅层缓慢移动，海面开始不规则翻涌，泛起密集气泡。大副停下手上的活，望向远方，表情从困惑转为警觉。船长注意到异常，手离开舵盘。两人目光交汇。船长猛拉舵盘，船开始偏离原航向，调头远离异常区域。

二、全速追逐

船已转向，但距离仍近。船长将油门推至最大，排气口喷出浓重黑烟，船体前倾加速，尾迹拉出一条长长白线。大副冲上前甲板，快速固定松散渔网、用绳索绑紧桅杆、关闭舱口盖——所有动作服务于高速航行。

远处，水下阴影也在加速移动。从渔船后方望去，那条黑色轮廓越来越大，与船之间的视觉距离正在缩短。压迫感逐步建立。

三、触须拍船·压力顶峰

船全速前进，阴影已近至数十米内，水下轮廓可辨——多条粗壮触须覆盖吸盘与珊瑚碎屑。一条触须从水下猛然甩出，拍击船体右舷，掀起巨浪将船掀歪近三十度。触须上滴落海水与碎壳。

船体剧烈摇晃。大副被甩倒在甲板上，单手撑住桅杆才稳住身体。船向左倾斜，舵盘剧烈震动。船长死死握住舵盘，双眼紧盯前方，身体前倾对抗倾斜，脚在甲板上蹬住防滑。

四、暗礁机动

船受创，右舷甲板积水，一道浅刮痕渗水，但船仍可操控。暮色渐浓。前方出现一片暗礁浅水区，礁石露出水面，水流湍急。

船长判断浅水可阻止水下怪物跟进，猛打舵头对准暗礁入口。大副瞬间理解意图，冲向前方抛出一根锚索，绳索缠绕在附近礁石上，使船在浅水区突然减速偏转，轨迹变得不可预测。船长配合调整油门与舵角，让船擦过礁石而非卡死。

船在暗礁区剧烈颠簸，擦过两块礁石后冲出浅水。水下，怪物的触须在浅水处受阻，拍打浅水但够不到船，被迫留在后方。

五、代价与收束

船已驶出暗礁区回到深水。怪物被甩在浅水后方，不再可见。海面恢复平静，但带着细密涟漪。

大副从舱内拖出一只破桶和抹布，蹲在右舷刮痕旁舀甲板上的积水。船体右舷可见一道深深的刮痕，水仍在持续渗出。船长在船尾回望——水下阴影已消失在海平线后。

两人一前一后，继续清理与操船。船缓缓向远处灯光与地平线驶去，尾迹在水中拉长。船体因渗水而缓慢下沉了一点，但仍在浮起。暮色中，远处港口灯光如细线，船的光影越来越小。

characters.name: 船长
characters.description_en: Photorealistic middle-aged man, weathered tanned skin with deep wrinkles around eyes and forehead, short grey-brown hair slicked back with salt-streaked texture, trimmed salt-and-pepper stubble beard, strong jawline, intense focused eyes. Wears a heavy dark navy oilskin waterproof jacket (crinkled, waxy, patched at elbows), dark oil-stained work trousers, worn brown leather boots, heavy duty rope belt with brass buckle. Build: solid and compact, broad shoulders, thick forearms showing years of physical labor. Distinguishing marks: small faded scar on left cheekbone, sun-weathered red patches on nose and ears, calloused hands. Maritime working attire, no accessories besides a worn fob on the jacket.

characters.name: 大副
characters.description_en: Photorealistic young man in his early twenties, light-medium warm-toned skin with a healthy sun-kissed glow, short dark brown messy hair swept to one side, clean-shaven with a sharp jawline, bright alert green eyes, lean athletic build with defined shoulders and narrow hips. Wears a storm-grey heavy canvas maritime work jacket with visible brass snap buttons and rolled sleeves, plain white cotton crew-neck T-shirt underneath, dark canvas cargo-style work pants with rolled cuffs, sturdy brown lace-up canvas boots. Distinguishing marks: small mole just below left ear, a faded tattoo of a wave pattern on the right inner forearm. Maritime working attire, visibly younger and leaner than the captain, with different hairstyle and lighter jacket color for clear distinction.

characters.name: 渔船
characters.description_en: Photorealistic small motorized fishing boat, weathered working vessel. Hull painted faded navy blue on the lower half with rust-brown gunwale and pale grey deck, showing salt stains, chipped paint, and rope abrasion. Low freeboard with a pointed bow and flat raked stern. The open piloting area at the stern has a simple ship's wheel, an oil-stained bench seat, and a small instrument panel; a single thin mast carries rigging and a small antenna; the outboard/inboard motor stack is painted dark with exhaust pipes emitting dense black smoke. Bow deck holds coiled fishing net, wooden crates, and a small winch. Realistic cinematic maritime film texture, photorealistic material quality, no cartoon or game look. One identifiable vessel reused across all exterior and deck angles: same silhouette, same paint, same rigging.

characters.name: 海怪
characters.description_en: Photorealistic colossal Cthulhu-style sea monster, one identifiable entity in every pose. Massive bulbous head with a crown of thick, fleshy, tapering tentacles radiating outward like fronds; each tentacle studded with large round suckers encrusted with marine debris (broken coral pieces, barnacle shells, seaweed). Under the head arch, two wide, dark, lightless eyes set in wrinkled flesh. Body surface: glossy, leathery, rubbery skin in deep umber, dark rust, and ink-black tones, heavily wet with visible water streaming down, covered in mottled scales and ridged folds. Colossal scale: when near the fishing boat, its tentacles alone are thicker than the boat's entire width. Realistic cinematic maritime film quality, photorealistic wet organic material, no cartoon or game look. Same entity identifiable across all viewpoints and sizes.

scenes.title: 全速追逐
scenes.summary: 剧情任务：建立追逐紧迫感。起始状态：船已转向，远离异常区域，但距离仍近。主动作：船长将油门推至最大，排气口喷出浓重黑烟，船体前倾加速，尾迹拉出白线；大副冲上前甲板，快速固定松散渔网、用绳索绑紧桅杆、关闭舱口盖——所有动作服务于高速航行。结果状态：船全速航行，但远处水下阴影也在加速移动，两者之间的视觉距离正在缩短，压迫感逐步建立。

shots.description: 船已转向远离异常区域。引擎轰鸣，排气口喷出浓重黑烟，船体前倾加速，白色尾迹在船后拉成一道长线；海面被船速撕开。以船体侧面为主，突出「正在逃离」的动态。画面中无可见人物，空船无人，禁卡通风格。

shots.motion: 船加速前倾，黑烟升腾，尾迹拉长，水面被开
shots.opening_state: 船转向刚完成、开始加速，黑烟初起
shots.composition: 船在画面中央偏左，黑烟向右上方升，尾迹白线向画面右后方拉长
shots.important_details: 功能：追逐紧迫感建立（逃离侧）。预计可见人物：无人（船体远景）。关键事件：全速加速、黑烟、尾迹。结束状态：船全速航行、尾迹拉满。源时长10s，预计保留时长10s。
shots.camera_movement: handheld follow（跟随船体侧向滑动）
shots.video_prompt_en: The small motorized fishing boat glides forward through the water, accelerating steadily from its left-side profile view as it moves away from the background. The hull pitches upward at the bow, straining against the acceleration, while the exhaust stack spews thick, dense plumes of black smoke into the air. A sharp, clean white wake extends straight backward from the stern, stretching across the entire width of the frame, tearing the ocean surface into frothy foam. Small wooden crates and coiled rope on the deck shift slightly with the heavy vibrations of the high-speed travel, while the camera tracks laterally alongside the ship, keeping the vessel centered and emphasizing its momentum and speed. The surrounding water becomes choppier, with waves crashing against the hull's side, as the boat races across the open sea, maintaining its straight trajectory with no other objects or people in sight.

scenes.title: 触须拍船·压力顶峰
scenes.summary: 剧情任务：展现威胁规模，压力顶峰。起始状态：船全速前进，阴影已近至数十米内，水下轮廓可辨——多条粗壮触须覆盖吸盘与珊瑚碎屑。主动作：一条触须从水下猛然甩出，拍击船体右舷，掀起巨浪将船掀歪近三十度；触须上滴落海水与碎壳。结果状态：船体剧烈摇晃，大副被甩倒在甲板上、单手撑住桅杆；船向左倾斜，舵盘剧烈震动；船长死死握住舵盘，双眼紧盯前方，身体前倾对抗倾斜。

shots.description: 极端大远景。机位贴近水面。一艘小渔船（占画面宽度约八分之一）在画面下方中央全速前进，白色尾迹拉满；前方数十米内水面下方，多条粗壮触须覆盖吸盘与珊瑚碎屑的暗色阴影贴近水下缓慢摆动，阴影比上一镜更近更大、压迫感顶点，触须仍在水下（水下轮廓可辨，非完整露出水面）。画面中无可见人物，只有渔船与水下海怪阴影，无第二艘船，无第三人，写实风格。
shots.lighting: 暮色光线昏暗，水色偏黑
shots.motion: 船全速前推，触须缓慢摆动，阴影逼近
shots.opening_state: 船全速航行中，阴影在数十米外
shots.composition: 船在画面下方中央，前方水面下的阴影占画面上半部
shots.important_details: 功能：展现威胁规模。预计可见人物：无人。关键事件：阴影已近至数十米、触须可辨。结束状态：阴影更近、船继续前进。源时长10s，预计保留时长10s。
shots.video_prompt_en: Camera fixed low at water level in an extreme long shot. A small fishing boat speeds forward at full throttle, positioned bottom-center and occupying about one-eighth of the frame width, trailing a long white wake. Below the surface, multiple thick, dark tentacles encrusted with suckers and coral debris slowly undulate closer to the boat. In the final few seconds, one tentacle from the right猛地 whips upward, striking the starboard hull, creating a massive splash of water and debris that leans the boat sharply to the left.

scenes.title: 暗礁机动
scenes.summary: 剧情任务：两人有联系的行动，动作互相影响结果。起始状态：船受创，右舷甲板积水、一道浅刮痕渗水，但船仍可操控。前方出现一片暗礁浅水区，礁石露出水面，水流湍急。主动作：船长判断浅水可阻止水下怪物跟进，猛打舵头对准暗礁入口；大副瞬间理解意图，冲向前方抛出一根锚索缠绕在附近礁石上，使船在浅水区突然减速偏转、轨迹变得不可预测；船长配合调整油门与舵角，让船擦过礁石而非卡死。结果状态：船在暗礁区剧烈颠簸、擦过两块礁石后冲出浅水；水下怪物的触须在浅水处受阻，拍打浅水但够不到船，被迫留在后方。

Turbulent white water churns violently around the hull as the vessel cuts into the rapid current. The captain, a middle-aged man in a dark navy oilskin jacket, stands at the stern wheel, his body leaning into the turn with intense focus. He grips the wheel tightly, executing a swift and decisive adjustment of the rudder to align the ship's trajectory with the narrow passage between the large submerged rocks and the water's surface.

No human, no person, no man, no woman, no captain, no crew member, no fisherman, no standing figure, no silhouette on the horizon, no one at the wheel, no one on the deck, no one in the water, zero living beings. Only the boat, the water, and the air. shots.note: 首帧复核（P51-E）：新首帧场景身份=礁石海岸+白色碎浪（分镜明确禁止礁石/海岸/碎浪），与「开阔海面+远处浅水触须受阻」矛盾，属连续 attractor 未破。分镜描述正确不改；视频阶段建议改用 multi relay（接力 s04_c03 尾帧作场景先验）而非 i2v 锁此缺陷首帧，或重建首帧。

scenes.title: 代价与收束
scenes.location: 开阔海面（远处有港口灯光）
scenes.summary: 剧情任务：可观察结果与收束，付出代价。起始状态：船已驶出暗礁区回到深水，怪物被甩在浅水后方，不再可见。主动作：大副从舱内拖出一只破桶和抹布，蹲在右舷刮痕旁舀甲板上的积水；船体右舷可见一道深深的刮痕与持续渗水。船长在船尾回望——水下阴影已消失在海平线后，海面恢复平静但带着细密涟漪。结果状态：两人一前一后继续清理与操船，船缓缓向远处灯光与地平线驶去，尾迹在水中拉长，船体缓慢下沉一点但仍在浮起。

shots.description: 开阔海面，暮色，远处港口灯光微弱暖色光点。船已驶出暗礁区回到深水，怪物已完全消失不见（画面中无任何水下阴影、无触须、无任何海怪），海面平静只有细密涟漪。右舷船体上一道深深的刮痕清晰可见，刮痕处持续渗出海水，甲板上有一片积水。大副（年轻男性，水手服，灰蓝工装外套+白T恤+深色裤+棕靴）蹲在右舷刮痕旁，双手拖着一只破桶和抹布，正蹲着舀甲板上的积水，动作缓慢而疲惫。MS 取景：框入大副膝上至头顶及右舷刮痕局部，不出现整艘船全貌。画面中只有大副一人，无第三人，无海怪，无帆船，无蒸汽船，无风暴巨浪，写实风格。
shots.lighting: 暮色灯光，远处港口暖色光点
shots.motion: 拖桶、蹲下、舀水、擦甲板
shots.opening_state: 船缓缓航行中，大副从舱内拖着桶出来
shots.composition: 大副在画面中下部蹲着，右舷刮痕与渗水在背景，远处港口灯光微弱
shots.important_details: 功能：付出代价的可观察结果（清扫侧）。预计可见人物：一人。关键事件：破桶抹布+刮痕渗水可见。结束状态：大副蹲着清扫中。源时长10s，预计保留时长10s。
shots.video_prompt_en: The camera executes a slow, subtle push-in towards the deck, keeping the first mate’s upper body and the chipped hull section in a medium shot composition. The first mate, crouching next to the deep scratch on the starboard side, moves with deliberate slowness, leaning forward to scoop a small amount of seawater from the pooled accumulation on the deck into a worn bucket. He gently drains the water over the side, his movements reflecting physical exhaustion. In the background, the open ocean remains calm with fine, subtle ripples under the twilight sky, and faint, warm lights from a distant port are visible on the horizon. The scene focuses exclusively on the quiet, repetitive action of water removal, with no other characters or creatures appearing in the frame.

first_frame_batches.prompt_snapshot: [SHOT SIZE: medium shot, eye level angle. 大副在画面中下部蹲着，右舷刮痕与渗水在背景，远处港口灯光微弱], Photorealistic young man in his early twenties, light-medium warm-toned skin with a healthy sun-kissed glow, short dark brown messy hair swept to one side, clean-shaven with a sharp jawline, bright alert green eyes, lean athletic build with defined shoulders and narrow hips. Wears a storm-grey heavy canvas maritime work jacket with visible brass snap buttons and rolled sleeves, plain white cotton crew-neck T-shirt underneath, dark canvas cargo-style work pants with rolled cuffs, sturdy brown lace-up canvas boots. Distinguishing marks: small mole just below left ear, a faded tattoo of a wave pattern on the right inner forearm. Maritime working attire, visibly younger and leaner than the captain, with different hairstyle and lighter jacket color for clear distinction., Photorealistic small motorized fishing boat, weathered working vessel. Hull painted faded navy blue on the lower half with rust-brown gunwale and pale grey deck, showing salt stains, chipped paint, and rope abrasion. Low freeboard with a pointed bow and flat raked stern.
